subject: Final proposal and PoC dashboard: margin per project during the build
body:
Hi Lisa,

Thank you for the conversation about how Kramer Bouwservice currently tracks project margins. As discussed, the core issue is that during a running project you have no up-to-date margin per project, so course-correcting only happens after the project is already finished.

Attached you will find the final proposal and a proof-of-concept dashboard titled "Margin per project during the build". The dashboard is filled with illustrative sample data, not your real figures, to show what the insight will look like once it is connected to Exact Online and your timesheet data.

The proposal scopes this one problem at a fixed price. The next step is your approval, followed by a short scoping call of about 30 minutes with you and Erik to go through the Exact Online connection, the timesheet format and the 15% threshold. After that we start straight away in week 1.

Let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
[Your name]
